{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)

print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_count} patients appear more than once')
print(f'Number of rows: {len(data)}')
print(f'Number of unique patient_ids: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Confirm the highest sample_seq per patient is kept
# For each patient, find the max sample_seq and keep that row
# This will be the deduplicated dataset

# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
# This keeps the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
deduplicated_data = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Final count of unique patients after deduplication
final_patient_count = len(deduplicated_data)

print(f'Final number of unique patients after deduplication: {final_patient_count}')"}
